national.line: A Harvard study that followed shy babies for years found shyness is inborn brain wiring, but most kids outgrow it: of 10 very shy one-year-olds, only 3 stay very shy as teens.

pride.label: World Food Champ Finalists

pride.label: Project Teach Award
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Kyleen Oxendine, an East Elementary teacher, for winning the first quarter Project Teach Award on Oct. 19 for her Take Home Reading Success Kits.

pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Sixth Grade Center for winning the traveling Tiger Spirit Trophy again with a first-place finish in the 2026 Homecoming Parade.

pride.label: Perfect Bus Inspection
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's school bus drivers and mechanics: all 10 buses the Missouri State Highway Patrol randomly inspected on Oct. 20 passed, a 100 percent rating.

pride.label: Record Test Scores
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's school district for its strongest academic performance since Missouri testing began in 1998. Math proficiency hit 56.3 percent, 12.5 points above the state.

pride.label: Banking School Grads
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's Lathan Martin and Boone Shockley of Grand Missouri Bank for graduating from the Oklahoma Bankers Association Consumer Lending School in Oklahoma City, Oct. 5 through 9.

pride.label: Perfect Inspection
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's Parkview Health Care Facility for being found deficiency-free in its annual Missouri state inspection.

pride.label: Marching Festival

pride.line: Congrats to Marshfield's Marshfield Chevrolet for celebrating 100 years of serving the community.

pride.label: New City Administrator
pride.line: Congrats to Osage Beach's new city administrator, Keith Klostermann, a 30-year educator appointed by Mayor Richard Ross.
